implement_user_repository: implement a concrete UserRepository class that persists users to SQLite
create_user: create a new user by calling the repository create_user method with a User object
get_user_by_email: retrieve a user from the repository by their email address
update_user: update an existing user and raise UserNotFoundError if the user was deleted concurrently
count_admin_users: count the number of admin users by calling the repository count_admin_users method
